Title of the Event:  
 One day Hands on workshop on  “Creative Painting and Pencil Sketching”  for club members 
sponsored by SPICES an AICTE initiative organized by Arts & Crafts club.

22-02-2023 (Wednesday)

Event Description:  
 Arts & Crafts club, SVCE with the support from  the department of English, organized one day 
workshop on   ”Creative Painting and Pencil Sketching”  to promote interest and creativity and develop 
artistic skills in  painting and pencil sketching  among students. The workshop started with prayer song and 
lighting the lamp  by the dignitaries.  Guest of honor Dr. K. Suneetha Reddy , Head, D epartment of English 
explained the value and importance of painting . The chief guest of the program Dr. N. Sudhakar R eddy, 
Principal, SV College of Engineering shared his experi ence that he got  first prize for his painting during his 
schooling. He also motivated the students to develop techniques in painting.  
           The resource person Mr. N. Yugesh, Artist & Founder, Eesha fine Arts Studio, Tirupati showcased the 
self satisfaction and the recognition we get through the art of painting. All the club members participated in the 
workshop. Fevicryl, acrylic paint boxes and brushes were distributed to all the participants. Mr. Yugesh 

explained the techniques in painting  and shading while drawing on tripod and projecting pictures on screen in 
the morning session. He explained the techniques to be followed in pencil sketch in the afternoon session. 
Students enjoyed a lot  and made the workshop a grand success. Principal, Dr. N. Sudhakar Reddy distributed 
the prizes to the best performers in the end of the session.  
Targeted Audience:  
1st2nd and 3rdYear Students.
